zh.headline: 一点点完成，一座座成林。
zh.intro: 每完成一项完整任务，就为自己种下一棵树。
zh.progress: 这座岛已种下 {n} / 16 棵树
zh.remaining: 再完成 {n} 项任务，开启下一座岛。
zh.first: 第一棵树，从一次完成开始。
zh.firstHint: 去看板完成一项完整任务，树木会自动种在这里。
zh.recentHint: 每一棵树，都有一次完成的故事。
zh.emptyRecent: 你的第一项完成，会被记在这里。
zh.removed: 原任务已删除，种植记录仍保留。
zh.ruleHint: 父任务及全部子任务完成后发放；重复完成、重新打开和归档不会重复发奖。循环任务按已触发的完成批次记录。
zh.banner: 让每一次完成，都有所生长。
zh.bannerProgress: 累计 {total} 棵 · 第 {island} 座岛 {count} / 16
zh.earnedPlace: 第 {island} 座岛 · 第 {position} 棵
zh.childRule: 子任务与父任务一起计入一棵树。
zh.pendingRule: 整项任务完成后，自动种下一棵树。
zh.rankEyebrow: 与身边的人，一起慢慢生长
zh.rankTitle: 小小的排行，长久的积累。
zh.rankIntro: 和同一局域网里的伙伴一起，看见每一天的完成。
zh.roomHint: 创建房间并分享邀请，或粘贴伙伴的邀请加入。
zh.rankRule: 按完成时间统计，同棵数并列。周一开始新的一周。
zh.privacy: 仅分享昵称与树木数量；任务内容留在本机。
zh.encouragement: 排名只是小小的鼓励。森林的意义，是看见自己的积累。
zh.invitePlaceholder: 粘贴 dshforest:// 开头的邀请
zh.copyFail: 复制未成功，请选中邀请文字复制。
zh.hostHint: 保持这台电脑与 DSH 运行，同一局域网的伙伴即可加入。
zh.joinHint: 两台电脑需连接同一局域网。离线时个人森林会继续积累。
zh.leaveHint: 退出后停止分享，个人森林会保留。
zh.closeHint: 关闭后所有伙伴暂时断开，个人森林会保留。
zh.connectionLost: 连接中断，正在重连。已保存的森林仍然保留。
zh.celebrateHint: 十六次完成，长成了眼前这片绿意。下一座小岛已经为你开启。
zh.allLocal: 个人积累 · 尚未分享
zh.roomFailure: 房间暂时无法连接，请确认邀请和网络。

en.eyebrow: Give every completion a place to grow
en.headline: Small steps. A growing forest.
en.intro: Each complete task plants one tree of your own.
en.remaining: Complete {n} more tasks to open the next island.
en.islandDone: This little island is now a forest.
en.first: Your first tree begins with a completion.
en.firstHint: Finish a complete task on the board. A tree will be planted here automatically.
en.unlock: Fill the current island to unlock
en.recentHint: Every tree has a story of something finished.
en.emptyRecent: Your first completion will be remembered here.
en.removed: The source task was deleted. Its tree remains.
en.ruleHint: A parent and all its subtasks must be done. Reopening, archiving and completing it again do not grant extra trees. Recurring tasks count completed scheduled occurrences.
en.banner: Give every completion room to grow.
en.childRule: Subtasks contribute to their parent's tree.
en.pendingRule: Completing the whole task plants a tree automatically.
en.rankIntro: See each day's progress together with companions on your local network.
en.roomHint: Create a room and share an invitation, or paste a companion's invitation to join.
en.rankRule: Counted by completion time. Equal counts share a rank. Weeks start on Monday.
en.privacy: Only nicknames and tree counts are shared. Task content stays on your computer.
en.encouragement: Rankings are a little encouragement. Your forest is a way to see how far you have come.
en.copyFail: Copy failed. Select the invitation text to copy it.
en.hostHint: Keep this computer and DSH running so companions on the same LAN can join.
en.joinHint: Both computers must share a local network. Your personal forest keeps growing offline.
en.leaveHint: Leaving stops sharing and keeps your forest.
en.closeHint: Closing disconnects companions and keeps everyone's personal forest.
en.connectionLost: Connection interrupted. Reconnecting; your saved forest is preserved.
en.celebrateHint: Sixteen completions became this little patch of green. Your next island is ready.
en.roomFailure: Unable to connect to the room. Check your invitation and network.
